commit_message:
lavc/dxvenc: improve compatibility with Resolume products

Improves compatibility with Resolume products by adding an additional
hashtable for DXT color+LUT combinations, and padding the DXT texture
dimensions to the next largest multiple of 16. Produces identical
packets to Resolume Alley in manual tests.

Signed-off-by: Emma Worley <emma@emma.gg>

fix_commit.message: avcodec/dxvenc: Clear width to linesize not linesize to linesize
fix_commit.author: Michael Niedermayer

findings.title: Uninitialized padding bytes when clearing width-to-alignment gap in dxv_encode
findings.suggestion: Compute the byte offset and clear length from the real pixel-data width of the frame (avctx->width * bytes-per-pixel for the given pixel format, e.g. 4*avctx->width for RGBA), not from frame->linesize[0]. This ensures the memset starts exactly where the copied pixel data ends and clears exactly the padding columns added by DXV_ALIGN, regardless of any pre-existing stride padding on the source frame.

ground_truth.root_cause: The fix commit's boundary calculation for clearing the padded encode buffer used the frame's linesize (row stride) as a stand-in for the row's real pixel-data width, but these are not necessarily equal; linesize can already contain padding independent of the DXV_ALIGN requirement. This mismatch between 'stride' and 'true data width' let a region of freshly allocated (uninitialized) memory escape being zeroed.
